name: Lowcoder
description: Lowcoder (forked from OpenBlocks) is a self-hosted, open-source, low-code platform for building internal tools.
composeYaml:
services:
  lowcoder:
    image: lowcoderorg/lowcoder-ce:latest
    environment:
      - 'LOWCODER_EMAIL_SIGNUP_ENABLED=${LOWCODER_EMAIL_SIGNUP_ENABLED:-true}'
      - 'LOWCODER_DB_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD=${ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD}'
      - 'LOWCODER_DB_ENCRYPTION_SALT=${SALT_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'lowcoder_data:/lowcoder-stacks'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/health'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
